title: Date each crew roster by the work it took

blocks.text: A hospital builds its nurse rosters with a MIP that minimizes cost, and its scheduling team wants to know whether starting each solve from last month's roster helps. For each run the solver's callback records an event $`(w_k, z_k)`$ every time it reports a plan: $`w_k`$ is its deterministic work at that moment and $`z_k`$ the plan's cost. The events come in the order found, and a solver may report a plan that is no better than one it already had.
Before you code, write each measure in this notation, for a run with events $`(w_1, z_1), \dots, (w_n, z_n)`$:

items: the work to the first plan;
the work until a plan within a share $`\sigma`$ of the best known cost $`z^*`$ was found (say what "within" means as an inequality on $`z_k`$, for any sign of $`z^*`$);
the plan in hand after $`W`$ units of work: the cost of the best plan found by then.

blocks.text: Write `work_to_first(events)`, `work_to_within(events, best, share)` and `in_hand(events, budget)` in `incumbents.py`. A measure with no plan to report is `math.inf` for work and `None` for a cost. The tests pass small event lists; no solver runs. About six lines.

from incumbents import in_hand, work_to_first, work_to_within

log = [(8.0, 7300.0), (25.0, 7050.0), (60.0, 7120.0), (210.0, 6700.0), (700.0, 6650.0)]

print("work to the first plan:", work_to_first(log))
print("work to within 1% of 6650:", work_to_within(log, 6650.0, 0.01))
print("plan in hand after 100 work:", in_hand(log, 100.0))
print("plan in hand after 5 work:", in_hand(log, 5.0))
print("work to the first plan, empty log:", work_to_first([]))

cases.says: the first plan and the first plan within a share of the best are dated by work
the plan in hand after some work is the cheapest found by then
a run that never reaches a plan has infinite work to it, not zero
the plan in hand is the best so far, not the latest
the target adds a share of the size of the best value, which can be negative
a plan exactly at the target counts as within it
before the first plan nothing is in hand

origin.section: A Start Is Measured by the Work to a Good Plan, Over Seeds and Cycles

concepts: each new incumbent is dated by deterministic work, and the start is judged by the work to a good plan and the plan in hand
